resample.notes: Downgraded. GPU-CPU-GPU round-trip only in aggregate path for non-integer scale factors. Interpolation (nearest/bilinear/cubic) stays on GPU. No GPU kernel exists for irregular per-pixel binning.

polygon_clip.notes: Re-audit 2026-04-16: fix verified SAFE. Mask stays lazy via rasterize chunks kwarg; per-chunk peak bounded.

kde.notes: Graph construction serialized per-tile. _filter_points_to_tile scans all points per tile. No HIGH findings.

sieve.notes: False positive. Memory guards already in place on both dask paths. CCL is inherently global — documented limitation. CuPy CPU fallback is deliberate and documented.

bump.notes: Re-audit 2026-04-16: fix verified SAFE. No HIGH findings. MEDIUM: CuPy backend runs CPU kernel then transfers to GPU (documented limitation).

reproject.notes: Downgraded to MEDIUM. Fast path .compute()-in-loop is intentional (~22x faster); falls back to map_blocks when output exceeds GPU VRAM. 16x16 thread blocks already mitigate register pressure in cubic kernel.

rasterize.notes: Downgraded. Tile-by-tile graph construction with per-tile geometry filtering is the correct pattern. Pre-filtering ensures each delayed task gets only its relevant subset. O(n_tiles) bbox check at graph-build time is vectorized and fast.

pathfinding.notes: Downgraded. CuPy .get() is required -- A* has no GPU kernel. Per-pixel .compute() is only 2 calls for start/goal validation. seg.values in multi_stop_search collects already-computed results for stitching.

geotiff.notes: Fixed-in-tree 2026-04-16: (1) read_geotiff_dask caps total chunk count at 1M and auto-scales chunks with a UserWarning when exceeded (linear graph scaling confirmed: 16384 tasks/1109ms vs 16 tasks/65ms baseline). (2) _nvcomp_batch_compress deflate path now batches GPU->CPU adler32 transfers via a single contiguous .get() and memoryview slicing, eliminating N per-tile sync points. 435 geotiff tests pass (2 pre-existing matplotlib deepcopy unrelated).

zonal.notes: Fixed-in-tree 2026-04-16: rewrote hypsometric_integral dask path. Eliminated double-compute (_unique_finite_zones removed, each block discovers own zones). Replaced np.stack (O(n_blocks * n_zones) scheduler memory) with streaming dict-merge (O(n_zones)). 29 existing tests pass.

viewshed.notes: Tier B memory estimate tightened from 280 to 368 bytes/pixel (accounts for lexsort double-alloc + computed raster). astype copy=False avoids needless float64 copy.

visibility.notes: Re-audit after Numba-ize (PR 1177) confirms SAFE. @ngjit kernels clean, type-stable. MEDIUM: K-observer graph growth in cumulative_viewshed (recommend periodic persist).

proximity.notes: Memory guard added to line-sweep path. KDTree path (EUCLIDEAN/MANHATTAN + scipy) already had guards. GREAT_CIRCLE unbounded path already guarded.

classify.notes: Fixed-in-tree 2026-04-16: _run_dask_head_tail_breaks now persists data_clean once and fuses mean+head_count per iter (912ms -> 339ms, 0.37x IMPROVED); added _run_dask_box_plot that samples via _generate_sample_indices instead of boolean fancy indexing on dask array; _run_dask_cupy_box_plot likewise. 85 existing classify tests pass.

glcm.notes: Downgraded to MEDIUM. da.stack without rechunk is scheduling overhead, not OOM risk.

surface_distance.notes: Memory guard added to dd_grid allocation.

cost_distance.notes: Re-audit 2026-04-16 after PR 1192 Bellman-Ford fix. 4 HIGH re-surface in iterative tile_cache path (L645 full-dataset materialization, L1015 da.from_delayed wrapping computed tiles). Finite max_cost path remains SAFE. Unbounded path is fundamentally O(dataset) driver memory — covered by #1118.

mahalanobis.notes: False positive. Numpy path materializes by design. Dask path uses lazy reductions + map_blocks.

aspect.notes: northness/eastness now use da.cos/sin on dask arrays.

hillshade.notes: Re-audit after Horn's method rewrite (PR 1175): clean stencil, map_overlap depth=(1,1), no materialization. Zero findings.

diffusion.notes: Scalar diffusivity now passed as float to chunks. DataArray diffusivity passed as dask array via map_overlap.

normalize.notes: Boolean indexing replaced with lazy nanmin/nanmax/nanmean/nanstd.

polygonize.notes: Re-audit 2026-04-16 after PR 1190 NaN fix + 1176 simplification. No HIGH. MEDIUM: sequential per-chunk dask.compute loop at L1528 serializes work; _polygonize_cupy full GPU->CPU transfer at L665; per-value bin_mask alloc in _calculate_regions_cupy.

balanced_allocation.notes: Re-audit 2026-04-16 after PR 1203 float32 fix. 8 HIGH found (friction.compute L339, argmin.compute in iter loop L182, double all_nan recompute L206, stacked cost_surfaces allocation). Covered by existing documented limitation on #1114. Not refiled.

erosion.notes: Memory guard added. Algorithm inherently global.

dasymetric.notes: Memory guard added to validate_disaggregation. Core disaggregate uses map_blocks.
